en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a broad, tree‑lined street beside a fenced park. Large mature trees dominate the left side; pedestrians and children are visible along the sidewalk and near the park gate. A pram is being pushed in the foreground, and horse‑drawn vehicles travel along the cobbled road toward a small iron bridge or rail bridge in the distance. The scene suggests an early 20th‑century urban park frontage. No legible printed caption is visible on the image.
